verdict.rationale: Better Stack can be driven without its UI. Its docs cover global and team-scoped API tokens with Bearer auth, a REST API with create, update and delete for monitors (copyable curl examples, paginated JSON), and Terraform support for automating workflows, which together cover the core of headless automation. Missing for 10: a CLI or documented CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), in-depth Terraform docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
